hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}}"; { t="$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && case "$(git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath)" in .githooks|.githooks/|./.githooks|./.githooks/|"$t/.githooks"|"$t/.githooks/") ;; *) git -C "$d" config core.hooksPath .githooks;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
